Field
Description
Values:
TASKV1 (1)
TASKV2 (2)
TaskSchedulerAllowDemandStart
From task definition, can start task on-demand. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-scheduler-schema-elements [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-scheduler-schema-elements]
TaskSchedulerAllowHardTerminate
From task definition, can terminate task any time.
TaskExecArguments
TaskAuthor
TaskSchedulerUserContext
User context under which a scheduled task/job would be executed. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-scheduler-schema-elements [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-scheduler-schema-elements]
TaskSchedulerTaskData
Data that is associated with the task. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-
scheduler-schema-elements [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-scheduler-schema-
elements]
TaskSchedulerDeleteExpiredTaskAfter
Time that the Task Scheduler will wait before deleting the task after it expires. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/windows/win32/taskschd/taskschedulerschema-deleteexpiredtaskafter-settingstype-element
[https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/taskschd/taskschedulerschema-deleteexpiredtaskafter-
settingstype-element]
Description
TaskSchedulerDisallowStartIfOnBatteries
Dont start task if computer is running on batteries.
TaskDisplayName
Pretty name for entity referenced in forensics artifact (e.g., principal executing task.)
TaskDocumentation
Information on entity referenced in forensics artifact (e.g., task.)
TaskEnabled
Entity (e.g., task) referenced in forensics artifact is enabled.
TaskSchedulerExecId
Task action identifier.
ImageFileName
The full path to an executable (PE) file. The context of this field provides more information as to its meaning. For
ProcessRollup2 events, this is the full path to the main executable for the created process.
TaskSchedulerActionType
Action type: execute a command-line operation, comHandler, sendEmail, showMessage. See
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/taskschd/taskschedulerschema-actiongroup-group
[https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/taskschd/taskschedulerschema-actiongroup-group]
TaskSchedulerExecutionTimeLimit
Time duration allowed to complete the task.
TaskSchedulerLastTaskResult
Results from last task run.
TaskSchedulerGroupId
User group required to run those tasks associated with the principal.
TaskSchedulerPrincipalType
Principal type of a scheduled task, e.g., AllUsers, Authenticated Users, Creator, Group, LocalSystem,
LocalSystemAccount, NetworkService, System, Users, WinSQMAccount.
TaskSchedulerHidden
Task will not be visible in the UI if this is True.
TaskSchedulerLogonType
Security logon method that is required to run the tasks that are associated with the principal.
TaskName
TaskSchedulerNumberOfMissedRuns
Number of times the registered task has missed a scheduled run.
TaskSchedulerPath
Path to where the registered task is stored.
TaskSchedulerRegisterDate
Time task was registered with the scheduler, in 100ns resolution since 1601-01-01.
TaskSchedulerRestartCount
Number of times that the Task Scheduler will attempt to restart the task.
TaskSchedulerRestartInterval
Time between each restart of the task. The format for this string is PDTHMS (for example, PT5M is 5 minutes, PT1H
is 1 hour, and PT20M is 20 minutes). The maximum time allowed is 31 days, and the minimum time allowed is 1
minute.
TaskSchedulerRunLevel
Privilege level that is required to run the tasks that are associated with the principal.
TaskSchedulerRunOnlyIfIdle
Task is run only when the computer is in an idle state.
TaskSchedulerRunOnlyIfNetworkAvailable Scheduling task only when the network is available.
TaskSchedulerStartWhenAvailable
Scheduler can start the task at any time after its scheduled time has passed.

TaskSchedulerTaskVersion
Version number of the task.
TaskSchedulerWakeToRun
Scheduler will wake the computer when it is time to run the task.
TaskPriority
Priority for the entity (e.g, task) referenced in the forensics artifact.
TaskWorkingDirectory
Directory containing the executable or files used by the executable.
